`irs-990pf-johnson-patient-assistance.xml` is a real, publicly accessible IRS Form 990-PF sample return distributed in the [Giving Tuesday IRS 990-PF sample repository](https://github.com/Giving-Tuesday/990-PF), which is MIT-licensed. It is used only to exercise XML parsing and extraction of reported officers and grant recipients. It is not a donor list and must not be used to infer that any person donated or consented to outreach. The IRS publishes annual 990-series XML through its [official downloads page](https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/form-990-series-downloads).
